name: EPIC 220236947
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.8 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,415 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.81 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,775 K at its surface.
